<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)]]
**[[President of Afghanistan|Afghan presidential]] spokesman Sediq Sediqqi says that the government rejects the proposed "reduction in violence" by the [[Taliban]] as an "ambiguous term with no legal or military parameters". On Friday, the Taliban proposed a ten-day truce and to hold follow-up discussions with [[Afghan government]] officials. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/01/afghan-government-demands-long-term-ceasefire-taliban-200117083410030.html (Al Jazeera)] 
*[[Yemen Civil War (2015–present)]]
**[[2020 Ma'rib attack]]
***Eighty [[Republic of Yemen Armed Forces|military personnel]] are killed by [[ballistic missile]]s and [[drone strike]]s in an attack reportedly carried out by the [[Houthi]]s against a military camp in the [[Yemen]]i city of [[Ma'rib]], according to Saudi state TV. The Houthis have not claimed responsibility for the attack. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-51166943 (BBC)]
* [[Somali Civil War (2009–present)]]
**[[2020 Afgooye bombing]]
***An [[al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] [[car bomb]]ing kills four people and injures at least 20 others near [[Afgooye]], [[Lower Shabelle]], [[Somalia]].

;Arts and culture
*[[Megxit]]
** Officials within [[Buckingham Palace]] announced that effective around Q2 2020, [[Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex|Prince Harry]] and his wife [[Meghan, Duchess of Sussex]] will retain, but will no longer publicly use, the [[Style (form of address)|style]] [[Royal Highness|His/Her Royal Highness]], and will no longer receive public funds for royal duties. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-51163865 (BBC)]
** The couple will also repay [[pound sterling|£]]2.4 million of public money spent on renovating [[Frogmore Cottage]]. [https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2020/0118/1108328-harry-meghan-royals/ (RTÉ News)]
** The couple will keep their titles as Duke and Duchess of Sussex. While Prince Harry will lose all his [[British Armed Forces|military]] appointments, he will remain a [[British prince|prince]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/harry-and-meghan-to-lose-royal-funds-and-hrh-titles-from-spring-11912020 (Sky News)]

;International relations
*[[Seoul]]-based ''[[NK News]]'' reports that [[North Korea]]n [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (North Korea)|Foreign Minister]] [[Ri Yong-ho (diplomat)|Ri Yong-ho]] has been replaced. His successor is expected to be publicly announced next Thursday. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-foreign-minister/north-korean-foreign-minister-replaced-report-idUSKBN1ZH0B3?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[List of mass shootings in the United States in 2020]]
**A boy shoots and kills three children and a woman before being arrested in [[Grantsville, Utah]], [[United States]]. A fifth victim is shot but is in a stable condition in hospital. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2020/jan/18/boy-kills-four-utah-mass-shooting (''The Guardian'')]
